title: DarkQuest: A dark sector upgrade to SpinQuest at the 120 GeV Fermilab Main Injector
excerpt: DarkQuest is a proton fixed-target experiment with leading sensitivity to visible dark-sector signatures, positioned as a dark-sector upgrade to SpinQuest at the Fermilab Main Injector (120 GeV); builds off existing accelerator and detector infrastructure; a Snowmass 2021 planning contribution, offering 'powerful but modest-cost' capability 'on a short timescale'.
